title: 15秒以上の動画で声の一貫性を保つために、まずSeedanceでBGMなし・環境音なしの「キャラクターが喋るだけ」の5〜15秒動画を生成する
content:
15秒以上の動画で声の一貫性を保つために、まずSeedanceでBGMなし・環境音なしの「キャラクターが喋るだけ」の5〜15秒動画を生成する  
生成した動画をmp3に変換し、そのmp3をSeedanceのキャラクターボイスのAudio refとして指定して長尺生成に使う

en.content:
To maintain voice consistency in videos longer than 15 seconds, first generate a 5 to 15-second video in Seedance with no BGM or ambient sound, where the character only speaks.  
Convert the generated video to mp3, and use that mp3 as the Audio ref for character voice in Seedance for longer video generation.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#AIart
I finally managed to break through the 15-second barrier in Seedance on my own 🤣
The consistency of the character's voice was a challenge in videos longer than 15 seconds, but
1. Generate a 5 to 15-second video in Seedance with no BGM or ambient sound, where the character only speaks.
2. Convert that video to mp3.
3. Use that mp3 as the Audio ref for character voice in Seedance.

This solved the issue ✨

I'll share a reference video, but please focus only on the voice consistency as the direction is terribly poor this time 😅

via @get_artcraft

2. 그 영상을 mp3로 변환
